name: Te to Te o Tsunaida Ano Hi o
original_name: てとてをつないだあの日を
source:
The sky hadn't changed. From that place, that time. My parents were dealing with things and sent me to study abroad. 

I did a homestay and returned to Japan.

What once felt like forever was now like some kind of vacation.

I slipped back into life in Japan. My little town.

I met old friends. We passed the time.

Then my mind awoke with a lightning bolt of a memory.

There was a promise I had made her, before it all.

"Why are you going away?" she asked.

But I didn't have a choice.

She had clung to me and cried.

More than the promise my heart remembered the sadness.

That's why, once more...

That day we separated... we held hands...

Once more... 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE109531.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
天空没有变。从那个地方，那个时刻起。父母处理完事情后把我送去留学。

我做了寄宿家庭，然后回到了日本。

曾经感觉永恒的时光，现在像是某种假期。

我重新融入了日本的生活。我的小镇。

我遇到了老朋友。我们一起打发时间。

然后，一道闪电般的记忆唤醒了我的心。

在那一切之前，我曾对她许下过承诺。

“你为什么要走？”她问道。

但我别无选择。

她抱住我哭了。

比起承诺，我的心更铭记的是那份悲伤。

所以，再一次……

我们分别的那天……我们牵着手……

再一次……
